games.name: Cook, Serve, Delicious!
games.summary: Cook, Serve, Delicious is a hardcore restaurant sim, one of the few in its genre that gives the players total control over where they want to take their restaurant.

games.name: Cook, Serve, Delicious! 2!!
games.summary: Cook, Serve, Delicious! 2!! is the massive sequel to the surprise best selling original, one of the few games that gives players complete control on how they want to build their restaurant. The game has you rebuilding your own restaurant in a massive skyscraper, earning money by cooking and serving customers delicious food and building up your restaurant’s reputation from a zero star dilapidated café to a five star world famous restaurant. Along the way you’ll jump into other restaurants in the tower for shift work, star in the biggest reality cooking show ever, participate in tournaments all over the world, uncover mysterious ingredients, and tons, tons more. The breakneck pace and gameplay has been a staple of the game, and this sequel will be even faster and more challenging than ever.
games.storyline: It was seemingly like any other morning at SherriSoda Tower as you take the elevator up to open Cook, Serve, Delicious!, a platinum star restaurant that was surging in popularity thanks to your amazing chef and management skills. Just then, a swarm of police surround SherriSoda Tower. It seems the SherriSoda head executives were secretly stealing funds from the company at the same time they were incurring a staggering amount of debt, draining the accounts of the tower and several of the businesses inside of it, including CSD. Just like that, the tower was closed and put up for federal auction, including everything inside of it. It was all over…the Cook, Serve, Delicious! restaurant was no more. Angry but determined to rebuild, you’ve scrounged up all of your personal life’s savings and bought commercial space inside the Teragon Supertower, the largest skyscraper in the city. It’s here that you will start a brand new Cook, Serve, Delicious! restaurant, build it back to its former glory, and rebuild your legacy as the best chef in the world. Good luck!

games.name: Cook, Serve, Delicious! 3?!
games.summary: Cook, serve and manage your food truck as you dish out hundreds of different foods across war-torn America in this massive sequel to the million-selling series!

games.name: Cookie Bakery
games.summary: Have you ever imagined owning a bakery full of unlimited amounts of cookies? In this game you will be able to make many cookies! Enjoy yourself playing this very fun game where the main goal is to make and make more and more cookies. Countless of fun and unique upgrades will have your back during this awesome indie game.

games.name: Cookie Clicker
games.summary: Cookie Clicker is a Javascript-based browser video game written by French programmer Julien Thiennot, better known as "Orteil". The point of the game is to bake cookies as fast as possible, to have a large number of cookies, and to have a lot of milk; notably, however, there is no true end to the gameplay. At the beginning of the game, the player bakes cookies solely by clicking on a giant cookie, gaining one cookie each time it is clicked. Once the player has enough cookies, they can use them to buy items that will bake more cookies automatically. The seemingly endless gameplay makes it a game that can last an indefinite amount of time.
games.storyline: Interpretatively, the closer you get to making more cookies than there are people to consume them, the more you turn the world into nothing but a race of sentient cookies, and aliens. The story can also be perceived as symbolism for corporations or monopolies getting carried-away, and forgetting all sense of their origins, or otherwise destroying their own foundations from within, when nothing but the next job/production is all that can be seen in life.

games.name: Cookie Cutter: Overkill Edition
games.summary: Cookie Cutter is a gorgeous hand-drawn techno-pop-punk post-kawaii Metroidvania. Play as the heroine Cherry on a quest for revenge as you run, jump, explore, and fight your way through a beautifully blood-soaked world. Overkill Edition features All new voice work! Brand new attacks and cut scenes, updated map features and tons of gameplay tweaks!
games.storyline: Rage against the dying world, sugar. The Void. The Matter. The Megastructure. A dystopian world with an egomaniac leader determined to unveil the secrets of the universe. INFONET promised a utopia built on the backs of tireless androids called Denzels. It was a lie. 200 years later the planet is decaying and the mysterious Red Seed has been stolen. Raz, a renegade mechanic, searches a hidden lab and discovers the Denzel Cherry, butchered and left for dead, clinging to life by sheer will alone. Her creator—and the love of her life, Doctor Shinji Fallon—has been taken by a demented sicko and Cherry intends to make him—and anybody or anything who gets in her way—pay. Fueled by love and powered by rage, join Cherry on a blood-soaked quest for revenge as she explores the massive Megastructure and eviscerates the armies of INFONET in an unforgettable over-the-top 2D platformer that breaks tropes and bones.

games.name: Cookie's Trails
games.summary: Cookie’s Trails is a cozy tactical puzzle set in a post-apocalyptic world with a sweet twist. The player guides a friendly hamster survivor through zombie-filled trails, collecting baseball bats and medical kits to safely reach the camp.

games.name: Cookiette and the Vanilla Crystal
games.summary: Cookie embarks on an adventure to find the Vanilla Crystal and defeat the Cocoa Witch, restoring sweetness to Sweetland.

games.name: Cooking
games.summary: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.

games.name: Cooking Arena
games.summary: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!

games.name: Cooking Arena Doner Delight
games.summary: Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon, where you can cook, chop, bake, and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes. But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning! As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC. Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations, keeping the grill hot, your customers smiling, and sautéing, mixing, and serving to the top. Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town! So put on your apron, sharpen your knives, and enter the cooking arena - life is a party, so let's cook delicious!

games.name: Cooking Arena Pancake Paradise
games.summary: Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes. But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning! As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC. Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

games.name: Cooking Arena: 4 in 1 Edition
games.summary: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits! Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes. But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning! As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC. Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top. Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town! So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious! This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Sweet Bakery Tycoon", "Food Truck Tycoon - Asian Cuisine" and "Burger Chef Tycoon".

games.name: Cooking Arena: 6 in 1 Edition
games.summary: This bundle contains "Food Truck Tycoon", "Sweet Bakery Tycoon", "Food Truck Tycoon - Asian Cuisine", "Burger Chef Tycoon", "Breakfast Bar Tycoon" and "Pizza Bar Tycoon".

games.name: Cooking Cat-Astrophe
games.summary: Cozy Yet Intense

games.name: Cooking Companions
games.summary: Solve the mystery deep in the woods of the Tatras Mountains. Will you butter someone up first? Or will you wind up on the chopping block?
games.storyline: Deep in the woods of the Tatras Mountains, supplies dwindle and flood waters are rising. It’s up to you to keep spirits high and make the most of your survival skills. Will you butter up the right person? Or will you wind up on the chopping block? Featuring Eastern European folklore in an unexpected package, Cooking Companions is a “dating sim” psychological horror title you won't soon forget. Players will be able to unlock 40 Steam achievements, 55+ pieces of artwork, four vegan recipes and 7 endings. WARNING: This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised. This game is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.

games.name: Cooking Craze
games.summary: Join the Cooking Craze! Prep, cook, and serve tasty food to earn achievements while you expand your culinary skills and grow a restaurant empire across the globe.

games.name: Cooking Festival
games.summary: Cooking Festival is a delicious management sim that will let you bake, fry and grill around the world! Become the master chef the cooking world has been waiting for and whip up some homemade pancakes, grill juicy ribs, bake aromatic original Italian pizzas, and serve delicious ice cream that everyone loves! Cooking is incredibly easy - just tap & serve! Start exploring the world and prepare whatever cuisine you like!

games.name: Cooking Mama: Cookstar
games.summary: Cooking Mama: Cookstar keeps the basic Cooking Mama formula with a few new features. The new vegetarian mode lets players avoid cooking meat-based recipes. Players can also show off their creations in the in-game social media network and build their clout over time. Players can use motion controls while the system is in docked mode, or alternate touchscreen controls while playing handheld.

games.name: Cooking Simulator
games.summary: Cooking Simulator is a single-player simulation game that recreates restaurant cooking using a physics-based engine and detailed kitchen mechanics. Players prepare a wide range of recipes from many ingredients, handling ovens, stoves, pots, pans, and utensils in a fully interactive kitchen. It includes several modes, such as a career mode where players run a kitchen and build up fame by filling orders, a free-form sandbox with no time limits, and a set of tutorials that teach the mechanics. Additional content adds themed kitchens and specialties like pizza, cakes, and cookies.

games.name: Cooking Simulator: Pizza
games.summary: Make pizza in the best cooking game! Learn how to bake authentic pizza and run your own Italian pizzeria!

games.name: Cooking Star Restaurant
games.summary: Open your dream restaurant!

games.name: Cooking Tycoons 2: 3 in 1 Bundle
games.summary: Sharpen your skill as you cook a variety of delicious meals all over the world! Become the master chef you always dreamed of becoming! Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! Spend your profits on upgrades on ingredients and appliances for your restaurant to attract more clients! This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Breakfast Bar Tycoon, Sushi Time, Food Truck Tycoon – Asian Cuisine. It also provides expansion packs both for Breakfast Bar Tycoon and Food Truck Tycoon – Asian Cuisine! Making dishes have never been so much fun and exciting!

games.name: Cookulo
games.summary: Cookulo: An experimental cooking game where your mission is to complete your Recipe Book!

games.name: Cop Car Police Simulator Chase
games.summary: Experience the exciting day-to-day life of an US police officer in Police Squad Simulator. Discover a large, lively and freely-accessible US city and ensure the safety in your district. Record traffic accidents, search for stolen vehicles and arrest criminals. Support other police officers at traffic checkpoints, flag down speeders and write them up. Stop and check every citizen or car you want and enforce the law. Pay attention to fugitive suspects and chase them on foot or by car with lights flashing and sirens blaring. Investigate crime scenes, interrogate witnesses and search for evidence. Get behind the wheel of three realistically recreated police vehicles with functional cockpits and use the in-car-computer to identify wanted suspects and stolen vehicles. Start with a typical police sedan and change to an all-terrain SUV and a fast police muscle car while you progress in the game. Use the siren to stop cars or to pave your way through heavy traffic in an emergency. If you crash or damage your car, you will not only have visible crash deformations, the handling of the car will also become more difficult.

games.name: Cop Officers: Police Simulator of NYPD City
games.summary: Be the Hero Who Protects: Your City Needs You!

games.name: Cop Police Escape: Racing Zone Clash
games.summary: Welcome to Cop Police Escape Racing Zone Clash, an exhilarating arcade-style game where you can experience the thrill of driving different cars in challenging situations.

games.name: Copperbell
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a unique hand drawn short adventure game and help Copperbell defeat the demon that has settled in the nearby forest.

games.name: Coral & The Abyss
games.summary: Coral & The Abyss is a sci-fi 2D action RPG with skilled hack’n slash combat and soulslike elements where you explore a mysterious world filled with ambiguous characters and challenging enemies. Explore, fight and survive as you ascend to the peak of the abyss.

games.name: Coralia and the Ocean of Stars
games.summary: Dive in for a cheeky ocean to space rescue

games.name: Coralina
games.summary: An investigation through space and time in a retro RPG that blends different art styles.

games.name: Corbid! A Colorful Adventure
games.summary: Have fun helping Corbid to overcome the mazes to be crowned champion. Eat, mix and shoot colors to solve the puzzles of Corbid! A Colorful Adventure, a cute 3D platformer for all audiences.

games.name: Cordels & Spells
games.summary: Cordels & Spells is a thrilling cooperative twin-stick shooter action adventure based in the culture of cordel literature. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle gangs of bandits, and recover the Enchanted Cordels, magical artifacts that hold the history and essence of Northeast Brazil.

games.name: Core Keeper
games.summary: Explore an endless cavern of creatures, relics and resources in a mining sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Mine, build, fight, craft and farm to unravel the mystery of the ancient Core.
games.storyline: Drawn towards a mysterious relic, you are an explorer who awakens in an ancient cavern of creatures, resources and trinkets. Trapped deep underground will your survival skills be up to the task?

games.name: Core.Sys
games.summary: Break in, retrieve highly protected data and get out clean in a fast-paced hacking simulation!

games.name: Corgi's Travel
games.summary: A scientist is conducting experiments with a machine that can shrink objects. To ensure safety, he decides to do the experiments a bit away from his house, but he makes the mistake of bringing his dog along. Without the scientist noticing, the dog accidentally presses the machine's button, getting shrunk and gaining superpowers. Thus begins the dog's journey back home, trying to find a way to reverse the effect and return to normal size, while facing various challenges, including giant insects.

games.name: Corn Kidz 64
games.summary: The unauthorized, kid-friendly version of the classic Stephen King thriller (or maybe not, maybe it's just a game about one-horned goatbabies)

games.name: Corner Driver
games.summary: If you love racing and want to test out your skills, try out this interesting arcade racing game today!

games.name: Cornfield
games.summary: Death Hides in the Harvest!

games.name: Cornhole
games.summary: Toss beanbags onto the board or into the hole to score in this fun party game!

games.name: Coromon
games.summary: Coromon is a modern monster taming game with retro pixelart. Coromon brings an immersive storyline, strategic turn-based combat and challenging puzzles to a classic genre.
games.storyline: The sun begins to dawn on Velua, a new day for the world and a new day for you, a freshly minted Battle Researcher of the global research society known as Lux Solis. It’s your first day and everything goes smoothly until a mysterious force attacks your latest workplace. Build up a squad of Coromon, track down the invaders, and grapple with a rising threat that endangers everyone on Velua!

games.name: Coromon: Rogue Planet
games.summary: Choose your starter Coromon, upgrade your gear, then battle your way across the wilderness of Velua in a modern-day Monster Tamer with a Roguelite twist! Tame monsters, battle Crimsonite bosses, and uncover the secrets of the galaxy!

games.name: CorpoNation: The Sorting Process
games.summary: Greetings, valued employee. You have been tasked with sorting the Ringo CorpoNation's genetic samples. With the credits that you earn, you can shop, game and pay your bills on time. Rogue workers may try to entice you into betraying your beloved employer, but we know you'll give 110%.

games.name: Corpse Factory
games.summary: Discard your sense of morality and enter the world of CORPSE FACTORY. Experience fear and suspense in this chilling visual novel! CORPSE FACTORY is a visual novel driven by pure suspense. It's part horror and part psychological thriller. The story is told in a linear fashion, with a few key choices to make along the way that will affect the ending of the game.
games.storyline: //TOKYO, 20XX: Whispers and rumors are spreading through the streets of metropolitan Tokyo like wildfire. Murmurings of a bizarre website have started to pique the interest of more than a few people—people willing to take extreme risks in order to fulfill their darkest desires. Corpse Girl's Website supposedly allows users to request the death of someone they know. All that is required is a photo of the proposed victim. Once an image is uploaded, the website promises to snuff out the victim's soul within a matter of days. Victims of the website apparently receive a photograph of their own corpse—even before they are dead. Photos are time stamped with a date... Perhaps a predicted time of death? The website's authenticity is questionable at best. It has become an interesting topic of conversation and nothing more. And yet... When people start dying in odd ways across the city, the website instantly returns to the limelight. All of the recent victims were found in possession of strange photos—photos of their own corpses, received only hours before they died...

games.name: Corpse Killer: 25th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: You're stranded on an uncharted island of Death. You're zombifying from Voodoo poison. A mad scientist is on your trail. Hundres of rotting stiffs are crawling out of their graves to chew your guys, and you can't kill 'em. They're already dead.

games.name: Corpse Party
games.summary: A friendship ritual gone awry transports high school student Ayumi Shinozaki and her friends to an alternate reality version of a tragedy-stricken institution that stood on the site of their own school long ago. As the vengeful spirits of elementary school students threaten their lives and their sanity, their only hope of survival–much less escape–is to uncover the chilling details surrounding the murders of those trapped before them.

games.name: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion
games.summary: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion follows three high school friends; Haruka Nanami, Nemu Takanashi, and Maria Hitsugi, as they explore the Amare Est Vivere Hospital, testing a local urban legend as the streamer Nemu seeks to boost her subscriber count. Unfortunately for the three girls, the legend of “Ayame’s Mercy” is true, and they trigger a decades-old curse that sends them into a dark realm. Together they must avoid the vengeful spirit of Ayame Kirishima and other horrors from the hospital’s dark past as they search for a way to dispel Ayame’s curse once and for all.

games.name: Corpse Party: Blood Drive
games.summary: Corpse Party: Blood Drive is the direct sequel to Corpse Party: Book of Shadows, and is the first game featuring settings and characters rendered in 3D. Platform is PlayStation Vita, released in Japan in July 2014 by 5pb.. The characters are depicted in 3D chibi style, however traditional CG artwork appears during cutscenes, illustrated by Sakuya Kamishiro.

games.name: Corridor Z
games.summary: Runner game for mobile and handhelds.

games.name: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon
games.summary: Welcome to Cosmic Arcade Tycoon! Build your own Arcade in this tiny, cozy and casual sci-fi simulation! Unlock new objects, customize your layout and welcome cute alien visitors to create a flourishing entertainment hub!

games.name: Cosmic Coop
games.summary: 'Cosmic Coop', an alien farming/creature collector odyssey! Lure Critterlings with captivating objects, establish harmonious ecosystems, and ward off invaders. Delve into mines, craft for your farm, and chat with quirky native creatures. More than farming – it's deep cosmic bonding.

games.name: Cosmic Defenders
games.summary: Cosmic Defenders is a 2D fast-paced revolving shooter about a group of unconventional heroes who use the powers of nature in order to stop chaotic aliens from taking over the universe. Cooperate with other guardians, protect the galaxy from the wicked, and restore peace in three game modes: Story Mode, Survival Mode, and Versus Mode.

games.name: Cosmic Express
games.summary: All aboard the Cosmic Express, a delightfully brain-melting game where the puzzles are out of this world! Your job is to lay down the train tracks across a series of tiny space stations. Each alien has a home of their own, and there’s only room for one extraterrestrial at a time in the passenger car. It's cute, harder than it looks, and guaranteed to give you hours of challenging fun across hundreds of levels.
games.storyline: Plan the train route for the universe's most awkward space colony!

games.name: Cosmic Fantasy 2
games.summary: Turn your imagination over to a Cosmic Fantasy of epic proportions! Laura has been kidnapped, and you must reach her before it's too late! Cut a swath of destruction through the throng of monsters blocking the path to Galam's hideout to save her. Along the way, make friends, solve puzzles, and learn magic while incing your way toward a confrontation that will shake the cosmos! Interactive fantasy role playing takes on a whole new dimension with the addition of animated intermissions that will get you involved in the story! And what's more, the true RPG-style combat interface will put you right in the action. What are you waiting for?

games.name: Cosmic Fantasy 3
games.summary: A new and beautiful legend of the galactic heroes - the story of the protagonist Yu's father and mother

games.name: Cosmic Fantasy 4: Prelude to Legend
games.summary: Cosmic Saga Finale! Prologue - The protagonists from the first film, Yu and Saya, save the planet from crisis as the Algernon team.

parent_game.name: Cosmic Fantasy 4: Ginga Shounen Densetsu - Totsunyuuhen: Densetsu he no Prelude

games.name: Cosmic Fantasy 4: Van's Return
games.summary: The touching epilogue is finally revealed... The Cosmic Team is united!

parent_game.name: Cosmic Fantasy 4: Ginga Shounen Densetsu - Gekitou-hen: Hikari no Umi no Naka de...

games.name: Cosmic Fantasy: Bouken Shounen Yuu
games.summary: One of the first Japanese RPGs in a CD format, Cosmic Fantasy: Bouken Shounen Yuu is a traditional representative of its genre, with party management, dungeon exploration, random enemy encounters, and turn-based combat. Characters fight using physical attacks, but later gain access to psychic techniques, which are equivalent to magic spells in comparable games. There are anime-style cutscenes with voice acting which advance the story.
games.storyline: In this first game of the Cosmic Fantasy series, the player controls a young adventurer named Yuu, who travels through space together with a robotic motorcycle cat called Monmo. One day, their space ship crash-lands on an unknown planet. The heroes realize that the planet is in a civilization phase far inferior to their own space-traveling world, and resembles a medieval society. Upon visiting a village, Yū discovers that the clan of kobolds is threatening its inhabitants. What starts as a simple mission soon turns into a grand quest against an evil force, that will eventually lead Yuu to realize his role as a Cosmic Knight, whose task is to defeat intergalactic evil and save the world.

games.name: Cosmic Hare
games.summary: A puzzling universe of talkative rabbits to jump.

games.name: Cosmic Holidays
games.summary: Help Cibo find his way in an unknown world. Through gorgeous flora and fauna, Cibo can glide in the wind, bounce, propel or block, absorb impacts or roll, using his power to inflate his head. Learn from hostile nature to make it your ally. Earn Cibo's trust until he reaches his vacation resort!

games.name: Cosmic Mirage
games.summary: Welcome to the exciting universe of Cosmic Mirage, where incredible space battles await you. Free the captured planets from the dark forces of the galactic conquerors.

games.name: Cosmic Robots
games.summary: Robots are invading – it's time to fight back! Build defences, lead armies, and defend your planet in this action-packed tower defence saga!

games.name: Cosmic Star Heroine
games.summary: "3 exotic planets to explore. Aliens. Robots. Magic. Forbidden technology. Ruined Worlds. Ghosts. Long-lost secrets. Conspiracies. A galactic threat. And one brave heroine to make things right. Cosmic Star Heroine is an exciting new RPG from the creators of Cthulhu Saves the World."
games.storyline: "Alyssa L'Salle was one of the top secret agents at the Agency of Peace & Intelligence on the Planet Araenu. But when she uncovers a horrible conspiracy, she has to go rogue in order to save the day! Can Alyssa save the galaxy when everyone (and everything) is out to stop her!"

games.name: Cosmic Top Secret
games.summary: Do we really, truly know our parents? Based on incredible real-life events, help T uncover the truth about her parents’ work as spies during the Cold War. Featuring real audio and documentary footage in a fantastical storybook world, Cosmic Top Secret is an adventure like no other.

games.name: CosmicBreak Gun & Slash
games.summary: A hack and slash with the "CosmicBreak" characters! "CosmicBreak Gun & Slash" is a spin-off of "CosmicBreak", an MMO battle shooter featuring robots and humanoids! Take control of familiar characters from a top-down perspective and defeat enemy robots that come at you!

games.name: Cosmo Player Z
games.summary: A Sci-Fi action game for a single player bringing you to fight rebellions, level up your character and choose new skills, dress up your character in the epic space wars.

games.name: CosmoDreamer
games.summary: From the popular free game "Outside" comes a dreamy and cute barrage shmups. The visuals are colorful, cute and fantastic, and the game features active gameplay.

games.name: Cosmonauta
games.summary: Cosmonauta is a platform game when the player have a lot of challenges, this adventure need more than your reflexes and determination. In a space exploration the cosmonauta have a navigation system issues and now need avoid the dangerous unknown world to find his way home.

games.name: Cosmos Bit
games.summary: Cosmos Bit is an old school metroidvania that will take you in an extraterrestrial world painted with the legendary Amstrad CPC's colour palette, reworked for modern devices. The game is enjoyable for both veterans and newbies of this genre!

games.name: Cosplay Love!: Enchanted Princess
games.summary: A lonely young lady who cosplays alone. A young, rookie designer chasing his dream. When these two meet, they open a brand new path through "cosplay"! A slightly erotic, young romance story between two people brought together by cosplay.

games.name: Cotton 100%
games.summary: Cotton 100% was released in 1994 and is based on the original Cotton: Fantastic Night Dreams. It offers a stunning and fresh new look with the more vibrant color palette of the Super Famicom. Experience the beautiful and authentic Cute 'em Up action from the 90s in all its glory and charm!
games.storyline: The world has fallen into darkness, and the fairy Silk sets out to look for help. She crosses paths with a young witch called Nata de Cotton, who seems rather uninterested in helping her. That is until Silk tells her that along the way, giant Willows, a candy that Cotton has a massive craving for, are waiting for her, so the two set out to find out what's causing the darkness... or look for Willows!

games.name: Cotton 16Bit Tribute: Special Pack - Limited Edition
games.summary: This edition includes the following: - Game: Cotton 16Bit - Handkerchief - Postcard - Soundtrack - Outer Box

games.name: Cotton 2: Saturn Tribute
games.summary: Set in the Pumpkin Kingdom which has lost its national treasure—the "Bluewater Willow," this brain-stimulating action-shooter follows Cotton, a witch with the biggest appetite in the universe, and Appli, the most tomboyish girl in the royal family. This is the fourth installment in the fantasy shooting game series featuring Cotton, one of SUCCESS's most popular characters. This masterpiece of the past is given new life using the specially-developed "Zebra Engine." The new features included such as game rewind, slow mode, and quick save greatly improve ease of play. Online rankings have also been added!

games.name: Cotton Boomerang: Saturn Tribute
games.summary: There are team battles this time! Take full advantage of all the amplified action and push forward! Set in the Pumpkin Kingdom which has lost its national treasure—the "Bluewater Willow," this brain-stimulating action-shooter follows Cotton, a witch with the biggest appetite in the universe, and Appli, the most tomboyish girl in the royal family. This is the fifth installment in the fantasy shooting game series featuring Cotton, one of SUCCESS's most popular characters. This masterpiece of the past is given new life using the specially-developed "Zebra Engine." The new features included such as game rewind, slow mode, and quick save greatly improve ease of play. Online rankings have also been added!

games.name: Cotton Fantasy
games.summary: Cotton Fantasy (aka Cotton Rock ‘n’ Roll) retains the comical world of Cotton and Silk, the game features not only from the Cotton series but also the other shoot'em up such as Sanvein's "Time" System and Psyvariar's "Buzz" system.

games.name: Cotton Reboot!
games.summary: Suddenly one day, the waves of darkness messed up the prism of light and began to inhale the light of the world. Then the night went on, the morning light was lost, and people were living anxious lives in the dark. On the other hand, the gluttonous wizard Cotton, who is completely indifferent to such things, does not know the request from Fairy Silk. However, when I heard that I could get my favorite Willow when I got rid of the monsters, it was so glittering! Anyway, the journey to explore Cotton Willow begins.

games.name: Cotton Reboot! High Tension!
games.summary: Sequel to Cotton Reboot!

games.name: Cotton Rock 'n' Roll: 30th Anniversary - Limited Edition
games.summary: This edition includes the following: - Game: Cotton Rock 'n' Roll, - Nata de Cotton Nendoroid, - Cotton Complete Works book, - Cotton Rock ‘n’ Roll original soundtrack CD

games.name: Cotton Rock with You: Oriental Night Dreams
games.summary: Cotton, the magical girl shoot-'em-up heroine, is back once again! This time, the adventure leaves the Magical Kingdom behind and heads to Japan.

games.name: Cottonville
games.summary: Create, farm, and style in Cottonville - a cozy dress-up game with farming and sim mechanics!

games.name: Couch Co-Op Bundle Vol. 2
games.summary: It’s time to get cosy with your best bud again for another round of unmissable co-op action. This bundle contains the following games, all of which feature local/couch co-op (as well as single-player modes): Black Paradox, Soul Eater, Bleed and Vertical Drop Heroes.

games.name: Counter Attack
games.summary: Experience the ultimate in next-generation detail, bringing the breathtaking power of modern warfare directly to your screen.

games.name: Counter Bottle Shooter: Pro Aim Master Target Bottle Shoot 3D Game Strike Pistol
games.summary: Counter Bottle Shooter is a game where your objective is to shoot all the bottles while standing still.

games.name: Counter Call: Half Escape Shooter
games.summary: Pressure never stops!

games.name: Counter Crossline: Crime War
games.summary: A single-player top down game that fights against terrorists around the world! The suspenseful stages in various places! Weapons that excite military fans!

games.name: Counter Delta 2: Eastern Crisis
games.summary: War clouds begin to gather over the Eastern European region. A single-player TPS game that fights against terrorists around the world! “Counter Delta 2: Eastern Crisis”is a solo single player/Third-Person Shooter. Team up with our soldiers to complete the battlefield mission. Enjoy a thrilling TPS game with a diverse play mode and various weapons that can be unlocked by leveling up.

games.name: Counter Delta: The Bullet Rain
games.summary: Counter Delta: The Bullet Rain is a solo single player/third-person shooter. Enjoy a thrilling TPS game with a diverse play mode and various weapons that can be unlocked by leveling up.

games.name: Counter Force
games.summary: Lead your team, fight with honor, and rise as a hero.

games.name: Counter Force: Tactical Warfare
games.summary: Are you ready to save the world from bad guys?

games.name: Counter Recon 2: The New War
games.summary: Counter Recon 2: The New War is a solo single player/first person shooter game. Enjoy a thrilling FPS game with a diverse play mode and various weapons that can be unlocked by leveling up.

games.name: Counter Recon: The First Mission
games.summary: Counter Recon: The First Mission is a solo single player/first person shooter game. Enjoy a thrilling FPS game with a diverse play mode and various weapons that can be unlocked by leveling up. Become a member of the Counter Recon Special Force, wipe out terrorist organizations and complete all the missions to see the true ending.
games.storyline: After the end of the Cold War in 1994, it seemed that the era of peace has finally arrived. However, since 2000, various non-governmental terrorist groups have been formed. In 2030, the ISS, the largest terrorist organization united all terrorist groups around the world and started to dominate cities. The ISS has become the most threatening terrorist organization in the world. At that time, new energy source was discovered that could change the future of humankind. The United Nations and…

games.name: Counter Shooter Strike Zone
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an adrenaline-fueled world of tactical challenges, weapon upgrades, and hidden treasures in this gripping shooter adventure!

games.name: Countless Army
games.summary: Have you ever dreamed of being the villain in a Tower Defense? Be the one who sends waves and waves of troops to break through the enemy defenses in this Reverse Tower Defense. Summon, conquer and upgrade your troops to dominate the whole world!

games.name: Country Birds: Brothership of the Valley
games.summary: This visual novel follows a young falcon who, after facing a difficult setback, embarks on an epic journey to rediscover his confidence and inner strength.

games.name: Country Tales
games.summary: Country Tales is a time management and strategy adventure set in the charming Wild West town of Sunset Hills. Join Ted, a hopeful young man who moves to the countryside after finishing university and finds himself helping the mayor while falling for his fiancée, Catherine. Build, manage resources, solve quests, and navigate through romantic entanglements and unexpected twists. With colorful visuals, engaging story progression, and multiple gameplay modes, Country Tales offers a lighthearted challenge for casual gamers of all ages.
games.storyline: Ted used to be a simple farmer, but he dreamed of more. After finishing his studies in the big city, he moves to Sunset Hills and becomes the mayor’s assistant. There, he meets Catherine — the mayor’s fiancée — and falls in love. As Ted helps build and manage the town, he uncovers the mayor’s selfish plans and must decide whether to fight for the town’s future and Catherine’s heart.
